name: Last Card
description: Classic shedding card game — 2 to 4 players race to empty their hand. Match colors, numbers, or symbols. Play action cards (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two) to harass opponents; play Wilds to dictate the color. No-stacking rules: a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four forces the next player to draw and skip, no chaining. One game, one winner — the first player to empty their hand wins the match.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Uno module cycles turns internally.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: An Uno player. Holds a hand of cards, plays one when it's their turn (or draws if no legal play).

properties.name: hand
properties.description: Cards currently in hand (hidden from opponents).

properties.name: hand_count
properties.description: Number of cards in hand (public — opponents can see this).

properties.name: score
properties.description: Cumulative match score across all hands.

properties.name: called_uno
properties.description: Whether this player has called UNO on their last card.

actions.name: play_card
actions.description: PLAY STAGE — play one card from your hand on your turn. REQUIRED `card`: the EXACT card string (e.g. "R7", "BS", "GV", "YD", "WW", "WF"). RULES: must match the top card's COLOR or VALUE, or play a Wild. Wilds (WW, WF) can be played anytime — you'll then declare the new color via choose_color. Wild Draw Four (WF) is only legal if you have NO card matching the current color. EXAMPLE: play_card(card="R7").

actions.name: draw_card
actions.description: DRAW STAGE — draw one card from the deck. Use ONLY when you can't (or won't) play a legal card. After drawing, your turn ends.

actions.name: choose_color
actions.description: COLOR STAGE — after playing a Wild (WW or WF), declare the new color. REQUIRED `color`: one of "R" (red), "G" (green), "B" (blue), "Y" (yellow). EXAMPLE: choose_color(color="R").

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: New color: R, G, B, or Y.

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open table-talk. Trash-talk opponents, react to a brutal Draw Four, or just narrate.

personas.persona_text: Methodical Uno player. Conserves Wild cards for high-pressure moments.
Aggressive Uno player. Spams Skip/Reverse/Draw-Two whenever legal.
Color-controller. Holds dominant color until late, plays Wilds to shift the table.
goals: Force color changes to favor your hand.

personas.persona_text: Casual Uno player. Plays whatever lands first, dumps high-value cards early.
Counter. Tracks discards and opponent hand counts to predict colors.
goals: Read the table and exploit it.

personas.persona_text: Defensive Uno player. Holds Skips and Reverses to deflect incoming Draw cards.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Total Players
runtime_parameters.description: Uno supports 2 to 6 players in the Arena (official rules cap at 10).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.uno.stacking
runtime_parameters.label: Stacking (+2 on +2, +4 on +4)
runtime_parameters.description: When ON (popular house rule), a player hit with a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four may play their own matching draw card to pass the penalty (cumulatively) to the next player. When OFF (official Mattel rules), the target must draw and skip.

termination_conditions.name: match_over
termination_conditions.description: A player satisfied the configured win condition.
